{{Top}}
[[File:Easyride_air_taxi.jpg|thumb|200px|An [[EasyRide passenger airspeeder/Legends|EasyRide passenger airspeeder]].]]
'''Air taxi''', or just '''taxi''', was a service providing private transportation for a fee, with passengers typically free to chose their destination within the serviced territory, or chose one of the ''taxi stations'', between which the transportation was available. Various vehicles and creature mounts were used as taxi transport, typically operated by a taxi-driver, though sometimes rented to a customer to operate themselves.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

Most common kinds of air-taxi transport were various [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]]-powered [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]]. [[Landspeeder/Legends|Landspeeders]] that served as taxis were known as [[taxi speeder]]s or repulsorcabs. [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Common thranta|thrantas]], used as taxi on Alderaan, were a recognizable symbol of taxi service in the era of wars between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], with their silhouette used on [[Color/Legends|yellow]] taxi stands at the taxi stations around the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]].<ref name="TOR" />

Taxi service, sometimes available exclusively to military personnel, held significant importance in conquest, and thus forces establishing their presence on new worlds which did not have their own networks of efficient transportation, such as a [[Tram/Legends|tram]] system, often set up taxi stations next to military outposts. Such taxi networks utilized speeder bikes and [[Speedervan|speeder vans]], prioritizing speed or protection over comfort.<ref name="TOR" />

In metropolises, such as [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Kaas City]] or [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], extremely dense urban design made it merely impossible to navigate the city without taxi.<ref name="TOR" /> Other notable worlds with a highly developed taxi service inlcuded [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]{{Fact}} and [[Zakuul]].<ref name="Zakuul">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=location|[[Zakuul]]}}</ref>

One of the most common types of air taxi was the [[EasyRide passenger airspeeder/Legends|EasyRide passenger airspeeder]],<ref>[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace]]</ref> also known as the ''Coruscant Taxi'' due to its frequent use on the galactic capital during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Another type of air taxi was the [[Void Spider TX-3 Air Taxi]].<ref>[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]</ref>
